references.text: The Lord speaks to Moses and Aaron together, the same formulation that introduces divine communication in a crisis situation with the people of Israel.
Later in the same chapter, the Lord again speaks to Moses and Aaron with the same introductory formula during the rebellion.
The Lord speaks to Moses and Aaron together, a pattern established early in the books of Moses for divine communication to both leaders.
The Lord speaks to Moses and Aaron in Egypt, the same structure for divine revelation to both.
The Lord speaks to Moses and Aaron with instructions, showing their shared role as recipients of God's word.
The same introductory formula where the Lord addresses both Moses and Aaron.
